QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and `__GNUC__` is present. Clang qualifies. MSVC, IAR, and armcc5 do not (`constant_time_impl.h:39-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus a compiler-predefined macro (`__GNUC__`), i.e. derived rather than set in the config file. It never says outright that it is not a config entry, but the derivation mechanism is stated.
